name: Renovate
summary: Open-source dependency update bot (AGPL-3.0, maintained by Mend) that opens pull requests to update dependencies and lock files, and can raise fix PRs from GitHub vulnerability alerts. Runs self-hosted or as Mend's hosted GitHub app. No MCP server was found in the official MCP registry and no agent-facing API was read; an agent drives it through repository config and the PRs it opens.

payments.notes: Source is AGPL-3.0. Mend's hosted Community Cloud is free for public and private repositories; Enterprise Cloud is paid, with purchase details from Mend sales; no price is published. Nothing prices a call.

agentAccess.notes: No Mend account is needed to self-host, but an agent needs an account on the git platform Renovate acts on. The hosted app installs per repository. No MCP server was found in the official MCP registry and no agent-facing API was read; that is the search result, not proof none exists.

jobs.summary: Proposes dependency updates as pull requests and raises fix PRs from GitHub vulnerability alerts, per the project's docs. Its measures (updates merged per month, vulnerabilities open past the policy window, breakages) are not published by the project and none is measured here.
